public_domain_rule.formula: D_l=ceil((9/8)*(1+delta_l)*B_l), domain[-D_l,D_l], B_l=max_j stored outward exact-real native bound
public_domain_rule.rounding: Parse finite binary64 B_l as its exact Fraction. Parse the outward decimal/rational uniform delta_l exactly. Multiply rationally, then mathematical integer ceil; no nearest rounding or observed-extrema fit.

public_domain_rule.margin_scope: The12.5% reserve is a fixed engineering design margin, not a proved native/NumPy/CKKS/refresh error budget. Same-input variance relation, domain membership and finite arithmetic remain conditions.

analytic_selection.unsupported: If no direct or prescribed rational candidate meets fixed analytic criteria, preserve all results and mark that site unsupported. Do not expand degrees, relax target, clip, or substitute native results.
